 Western Australia has named a 13-man squad for the One-Day Cup clash with New South Wales at the WACA Ground tomorrow, their final home 50-over match of the 2026-27 season.
 Exciting fast bowler Mahli Beardman makes his return to the squad, having missed last week’s clash with Queensland due to being a part of the Australia A squad that toured India.
 Top-order batters Cameron Bancroft and Jayden Goodwin have also been included in the squad.
 Bancroft missed the clash with Queensland due to illness, while Goodwin is yet to feature in the One-Day Cup competition this season.
 Fresh from making 29 on Sheffield Shield debut in dramatic circumstances yesterday, Corey Wasley has also been added to the squad is in the mix to become WA’s third List A debutant of the season.
 Fast bowler Kieran Elliott has been managed amidst a busy start to the season, while veteran Hilton Cartwright has been omitted from the squad.
 After a brief cameo in state colours last week, Australian T20 Captain Mitch Marsh will miss the match on paternal leave.
 WA squad for the One-Day Cup clash against New South Wales : Ashton Turner ©, Ashton Agar, Cameron Bancroft, Mahli Beardman, Brody Couch, Joel Curtis, Albert Esterhuysen, Jayden Goodwin, Liam Haskett, Will Malajczuk, Jordan Quiggin, Corey Wasley, Sam Whiteman
